code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild normocytic anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild hypoalbuminemia. There is also mild metabolic acidosis (low CO₂), and mild elevation of monocytes, eosinophils, and basophils. These findings may suggest bone marrow suppression or infiltration, possible chronic disease, and impaired oxygenation. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
